title: Userkare (Khendjer)
summary: Coregent of Pepi I in Dynasty 6 whom CFAH-6 identifies with Userkare Khendjer of Dynasty 13.
description: Coregent of Pepi I in Dynasty 6 whom CFAH-6 identifies with Userkare Khendjer of Dynasty 13. Person record added by the CFAH pass for CFAH's reign dates; dates are as printed in the CFAH paper cited.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year.

reign.citation: Griffith & White, "Chronological Framework of Ancient History. 6: The Old and Middle Kingdoms of Egypt," ARJ 18 (2025): 13–60, section "Userkare goes from D6 to D12/13 and back to D6"
reign.note: End of Userkare's coregency with Pepi I ("end of Userkare coregency"). CFAH then moves him to the Dynasty 13 position until about 1606.

reign.date: Start Co-Rex: 1637; Start Sole-rex: 1629/1628; End Sole-rex: 1613; Death or Deposition: 1606
reign.citation: Griffith & White, "CFAH-7A: A Chronological Baseline for Dynasty 12," OSF preprint of 11 Jun 2025 (no version number), doi:10.17605/OSF.IO/GMX5J, file CFAH-7A Chronological Baseline for Dynasty 12.pdf, Table 3 "Integrated Dates for Dynasty 12", p. 55
reign.note: Row "Usimare" of Table 3 (Egypt Dynasty 12). CFAH-7A lists him in Dynasty 12 as Usimare; CFAH-7B identifies this king with Userkare.

reign.citation: Griffith & White, "CFAH-7B: Kings of Dynasties 1-13," OSF preprint v1.3 (10 Feb 2026), doi:10.17605/OSF.IO/TUWNC, file CFAH 7-B Kings of Dynasties 1-13_v_1.3.pdf, Table 15 "EKL Solution Dynasties 4, 11, 12, 6", p. 103
reign.note: Row "EKL #17 Moscheres = Userkare" of Table 15 (Egypt (Eratosthenes King List, EKL)).

reign.date: Start Sole-rex: 1652; End Sole-rex: 1646; Death or Deposition: 1637
reign.citation: Griffith & White, "CFAH-7B: Kings of Dynasties 1-13," OSF preprint v1.3 (10 Feb 2026), doi:10.17605/OSF.IO/TUWNC, file CFAH 7-B Kings of Dynasties 1-13_v_1.3.pdf, Table 16 "Integrated Dates for Dynasty 6", p. 104
